I don't lie awake at night over it, but it's definitely in the back of my mind. I could probably be doing more.

**(C) Not too worried**

I keep a pretty close eye on my budget and have a decent handle on my regular expenses. There's always a little background concern, I think that's just part of adult life, but nothing that's keeping me up at night right now.

**(A) Very satisfied**

Family is really the foundation of everything for me. We have our ups and downs like anyone, but overall I feel genuinely fortunate with the relationships I have with the people closest to me.
